title: Nano Decoy
body: Right-click to throw it. It lands, opens into a glowing hexagon base and projects a nano copy of you: your skin built out of small cubes, with your name above it.

For 13 seconds the hostile mobs within 16 blocks go for it instead of you, and so do the mobs angry at you (wolves, endermen, piglins, golems, the Warden). They swing straight through it, and creepers do not explode at it.
Nothing can break it: hit, it glitches and drops a few cubes. At the end it falls apart into nano pixels and the mobs look for you again.
It is used up when thrown, stacks to 4, and the next one can be thrown after 20 seconds.
